WisconsinKiosk · redesign row H and C5

Kiosk Changes and Staff Actions

Extend, transfer, swap, and change a reservation from the hub, plus staff actions on someone's booking. Every screen calls the kiosk route that already enforces the rule.

New frames (after only)

No before exists: the kiosk had none of these screens.

What changed, and why

Extend guessed

Was

A date picker on the booking sheet; the server refused a time that was too late only after Save.

Now

The screen reads the extend window first and says how late it can go and why.

Transfer was staff-only and invisible

Was

No transfer on the kiosk hub.

Now

Holders hand a checkout (all or some) to anyone on the roster, immediately.

Swapping a unit took two steps

Was

Remove, then add: two separate saves.

Now

One atomic swap; a problem unit goes through the damaged report on the return screen.

Reservation edits saved on every tap

Was

Each remove saved immediately during pickup.

Now

Changes are staged and saved together; any that fail are listed.

Verification

  • xcodebuild WisconsinKiosk on iPad Air 11-inch (M4) iOS 26.5 (created device): BUILD SUCCEEDED
  • npx vitest run tests/ios-kiosk- : 20 files / 65 tests passed (new tests/ios-kiosk-changes.test.ts checks request bodies and Codable keys against the routes)
  • git diff --check clean

Things to know

  • Captures prove presentation only; no live-server run of extend, transfer, swap, or reservation save.
  • The 'Something's wrong' path and the C5 entry from the home booking sheet were not captured (taps don't register in the simulator); C5 is captured through a hub fixture hook.
